info.title: Go contract: go-server ⇄ go-brain
info.description: Tag go-brain = routes go-brain serves; tag go-server = routes go-server serves. Money is integer minor units. The spend approval token format is in packages/contract/src/spend-approval.ts.

post.summary: go-server sends every room message to go-brain. Reply fast; Go answers later via postMessageOut.
go-brain posts what Go says (text and/or a card) into a trip room. Idempotent on out_id.

get.summary: The trip as Go should see it: members, decisions, bookings, money. Budgets only as the lowest band.

patch.summary: Go updates the destination, dates, vibe, stay or the day-by-day itinerary.

post.summary: Go opens a vote in the room (choice, private budget, or yes/no).
Close a vote and get the result.
Attach what the group allowed: the choice, the cap, refundable only, and who pays.
Record a confirmed booking so the Bookings tab and the receipt show it.
Record something someone paid for, split between members.
The fewest payments that square everyone up.
go-server runs the spend check and returns a signed, one-use spend approval for the vault, or why not.
Save a finished call: who asked, the goal, the outcome and the transcript.
